entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor I bought. It's a complete piece of garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mike Schmidt. Order number is... VF77819.

Thank you, Mike. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 38 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fault! The thing doesn't work! It drops the connection constantly and the readings are all over the place. Look, I **don't have time** to play 20 questions. I **just want money** back for this junk.
I understand your frustration. Sometimes a connection issue can be resolved with a quick firmware update or a reset. Would you be willing to try a few quick troubleshooting steps with me?

Absolutely not! I'm not a tech guy and I'm not wasting another minute on this thing. I want a **refund**. Are you going to process that or do I need to talk to someone who can actually do their job? Get me your manager.
That won't be necessary, Mike. I can handle this for you. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for your order. One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order details. I see you received it 38 days ago, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that timeframe.
Finally. So you're going to send me a label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. A prepaid shipping label has been sent to the email address on your account. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your full refund will be issued.
Okay. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. My apologies again for the trouble you had with the sensor. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
